subject: a small stylized lobster in clear colored glass
pose: claws tucked inward with looping antennae
art_direction: 透明青玻璃小龙虾的触须卷成珊瑚色双环，钳子内收形成优雅而古怪的紧凑轮廓。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Sculpt a small lobster from translucent aqua glass, with its claws folded inward and its long antennae curling into two compact coral-colored loops. Keep the body segmented but simplified, so the silhouette feels elegant rather than anatomically busy. Tiny dark glass beads form calm attentive eyes. Render the glass thickness, trapped air bubbles, and refracted color where the claws overlap the body, avoiding excessive sparkling highlights. Set the sculpture on a pale cream surface against a dark slate-blue background. The loops should frame the head without resembling a decorative wreath. Center the entire creature at three-quarter view, with every antenna curve contained inside the circular-crop area of the square avatar.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
